question: If AI can find weaknesses in the codes that protect our data, should we be more worried or more reassured?
reflection: Using AI to test our protections before attackers do could make the systems people rely on every day stronger and safer.

sources.subject: Claude autonomously broke post-quantum encryption experts missed for 2 years

one_line: An unreleased Anthropic model found real weaknesses in encryption designs on its own, while the main standard for connecting AI agents to tools grew up.

top_stories.title: AI finds flaws in encryption designs
top_stories.what: Anthropic says its unreleased Claude Mythos Preview found a weakness in HAWK, a signature scheme designed to resist quantum computers, and a faster attack on a weakened research version of AES.
top_stories.why: Neither affects systems in use today, but AI is becoming a serious tool for testing security before deployment.

top_stories.title: MCP becomes easier to run at scale
top_stories.what: The Model Context Protocol, the standard that links AI agents to tools, no longer needs a fixed session per user and adds central login control and a deprecation policy.
top_stories.why: Agent connections to organisational systems can now be managed like normal web services with central access control.

top_stories.title: Cheaper AI coding plan for India
top_stories.what: Cursor launched a low-cost plan priced for India, where its users tripled to over three million, though it leaves out top models from the biggest labs.
top_stories.why: Regional pricing shows how AI tools may adapt to large emerging markets.

top_stories.title: AI-written books take a large share of sales
top_stories.what: A study reportedly finds that AI-written books now make up about a fifth of sales in some Amazon categories, hurting human authors.
top_stories.why: This matters for cultural policy and for protecting local writers and publishers.

saudi_lens.text: The flood of AI-written books is relevant to Saudi efforts to grow Arabic publishing; clear labelling and support for human authors may become policy questions.
Regional pricing in India hints that AI tool makers could offer Gulf-specific plans as regional demand grows.

idea.title: AI content in publishing study
idea.pitch: Measure how much AI-generated content appears in Arabic e-book and children's book listings, and how readers react to labels.
idea.first_step: Sample 100 recent Arabic e-book listings and code signs of AI generation.

idea_kids.title: Secret code club
idea_kids.pitch: Children make simple cipher wheels, send coded notes, then try to crack each other's codes to learn why strong codes matter.
idea_kids.first_step: Print two paper circles with the Arabic or English alphabet and a split pin.
